description: Modernization tasks for the Bhoomi Backend Java 25 LTS runtime upgrade.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Bhoomi Backend runtime from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Addresses assessment issue: Java Version is not the latest LTS.
tasks.reason: The assessment identifies Java 21 as older than the latest LTS, and the project build and developer documentation currently specify Java 21.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade only the Backend Java runtime target to Java 25 LTS. Update directly relevant build/runtime/container configuration and Backend documentation, preserving current application behavior. Retain Spring Boot 4.1.2 and avoid Jakarta/framework changes. No application runtime Dockerfile currently exists; do not modify the PostgreSQL/PostGIS database image or unrelated configuration. Validate with JDK 25 using the Maven Wrapper clean verify lifecycle; do not add tests for unrelated behavior.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate known CVEs in Backend direct dependencies relevant to the Java 25 runtime/build upgrade.
tasks.reason: Confirm the runtime/build modernization does not leave known vulnerabilities in its directly affected dependencies.
tasks.requirements: Limit CVE review and remediation to Backend direct dependencies relevant to the Java 25 runtime/build upgrade. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched versions; document any required major-version change and its breaking-change risk. Verify the Backend build and existing tests pass. Do not address unrelated cloud-readiness findings or Frontend dependencies.
